source_text.body:
Build a bill-splitting app with browser testing
A reviewer had Replit Agent 3 build a working bill-splitting app in 8 minutes, with it testing the UI in-browser and flagging failures; it was slow and costs could add up.
Done with
RA
Replit Agent
What they did
The reviewer described a bill-splitting app to Replit's Agent 3 and skipped the option to generate a UI design first, going straight to building. The agent produced a working version, then ran browser-based tests that simulated user interactions. It flagged failures and explained how it planned to fix them.
How it went
A working app arrived in 8 minutes, with core functionality working and no obviously broken buttons or dead links. Most of the time went to testing and refinement, so it was slower than Lovable, which produces simpler apps.
Worth knowing
On the free plan, the reviewer used up the entire credit allocation in a single iteration, so heavy agent use could get expensive.
Try it yourself
with
Replit Agent
Copy prompt
Build me a simple web app that [describe a small everyday tool, e.g. splits a restaurant bill among friends, including tax and tip]. When it's built, open it in the browser, test the main flows yourself, and fix any failures you find. Stop when the core features work end to end, and give me a short list of anything you couldn't fix.
Original source: https://www.superblocks.com/blog/replit-review
